title: Change the profile cover and reopen settings to view the selected image
steps: Open Change cover and select Cover image 3.
Open the avatar menu and select Settings.

video_guide.summary: Compare the profile cover before selection, after Save changes, and after reopening. The saved star-trails image reverts to the old black-sand cover.

chapters.note: Profile settings begins with the black-sand cover.
The selected star-trails image replaces it in the open profile form.
The success notification reports Profile updated successfully.
Reopening Profile settings shows the old black-sand cover again.
